wrong_explanations.C: Issues related to IT compliance risk are tasks usually assigned to an IT strategy committee. The steering committee is more involved in approval and monitoring of individual projects and budgets.

questions.question: Which of the following is the BEST enabler for strategic alignment between business and IT?

options.A: Maturity model
options.B: Goals and metrics

wrong_explanations.C: Control objectives are statements that address how risk is going to be effectively managed by an organization. Control objectives, therefore, facilitate the implementation of controls in the related processes according to business requirements.
wrong_explanations.D: Responsible, accountable, consulted, informed (RACI) charts enable the assignment of responsibility to key function areas but do not ensure strategic alignment.

questions.question: An IT steering committee should:

questions.question: Who is ULTIMATELY responsible for data classification and protection?

options.A: Data steward
options.B: Data custodian
options.C: Data owner
options.D: Data controller

questions.correct_explanation: Data owners are responsible for data classification and protection. Their security responsibilities include authorizing access, ensuring that access rules are updated when personnel changes occur and regularly reviewing access rules for the data for which they are responsible.

wrong_explanations.A: Data custodians are responsible for storing and safeguarding the data and include information security personnel, such as systems analysts and computer operators.
wrong_explanations.B: Data stewards are oversight or data governance roles within an organization and are responsible for ensuring the quality and fitness for the purpose of the organization's data assets, including the metadata for those data assets.
wrong_explanations.D: The data controllers determine the purposes for which and how data are processed.

tips: ISACA's BEST answer balances control effectiveness, risk reduction, and auditor independence — eliminate options that compromise any of these.

questions.question: An information systems (IS) auditor has been tasked by an automated manufacturing facility for the risk-based audit of its distributed control supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems. Which of the following should be the PRIMARY task for the auditor?

options.A: Evaluation of communication architecture and connectivity interfaces
options.B: Evaluation of functioning of monitoring terminals, sensors and actuators
options.C: Assessment of total cost of ownership (TCO) for the SCADA systems
options.D: EvaIuation of usabiIity of automated controls for enterprise engineers

questions.correct_explanation: Communication channels over the Internet and even USB interfaces in air-gapped systems increase the risk of malware exposure (e.g., Stuxnet).

wrong_explanations.B: Monitors, sensors and actuator evaluation is not of the same gravity in risk-based audit as communication.
wrong_explanations.C: Evaluation of total cost of ownership (TCO)/cost-effectiveness is not the primary concern to an information systems (IS) auditor compared to malware exposure.
wrong_explanations.D: Usability evaluation is oflesser evaluation in the risk-based audit.

tips: MOST/PRIMARY questions ask which option carries the largest impact or coverage — rule out partial or downstream choices.

questions.question: During an audit, the information systems (IS) auditor observed that a user can log in to post a transaction and then change role to authorize the same. Which of the following is the BEST course of action for the IS auditor?

options.A: Ask the system administrator to suspend the user's access.
options.B: Check for suitable compensating controls.
options.C: Ask the database administrator to merge the two roles into a single role.
options.D: Record the finding in the audit report.

questions.correct_explanation: If a violation of segregation/separation of duties (SoD) is observed, the IS auditor should first look for compensating controls before concluding the findings.

wrong_explanations.A: The information systems (IS) auditor cannot recommend suspending the user's access.
wrong_explanations.C: An IS auditor would not recommend merging the two roles into a single role, because that is a violation of SoD.
wrong_explanations.D: The IS auditor identifies and evaluates all controls before recording findings.

tips: ISACA's BEST answer balances control effectiveness, risk reduction, and auditor independence — eliminate options that compromise any of these.

questions.question: Which of the following is the PRIMARY objective of an enterprise architecture (EA) framework?

options.A: To provide a business case for developing and implementing IT systems and applications
options.B: To manage IT-related risk and ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements
options.C: To ensure the efficient and effective use of IT resources and capabilities
options.D: To align IT with business objectives and strategy and facilitate decision making and innovation

questions.correct_explanation: EA provides a holistic and integrated view of the enterprise's IT architecture and aligns IT with its business objectives and strategy, The primary objective of EA is to facilitate decision making, innovation and agility by providing a comprehensive and up-to-date understanding of the enterprise's IT capabilities and resources and how they can be leveraged to support the enterprise's goals.

wrong_explanations.A: Providing a blueprint for developing and implementing IT systems is an important aspect of enterprise architecture (EA), but it is not the primary objectives.
wrong_explanations.B: Although EA can also help manage IT-related risk and ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, these are not the primary objectives of an EA framework.
wrong_explanations.C: Ensuring the efficient and effective use of IT resources and capabilities is also an important aspect of EA, but it is not the primary objective.

tips: MOST/PRIMARY questions ask which option carries the largest impact or coverage — rule out partial or downstream choices.

questions.question: Which of the following would be MOST appropriate for helping to detect sensitive information that is stored on the enterprise hard drive(s) with inappropriate authorization or security controls?

options.A: intrusion detection system (IDS)
options.B: data loss prevention (DLP)
options.C: intrusion prevention system (IPS)
options.D: Transport Layer Security (TLS)

questions.correct_explanation: Data loss prevention (DLP) systems identify sensitive information stored on endpoint systems or in transit over a network.

wrong_explanations.A: Intrusion detection systems (IDS) identify some sensitive information using signatures built for that purpose, but they are not as effective as data loss prevention (DLP) systems for detecting sensitive information.
wrong_explanations.C: Intrusion prevention systems (IPSs) prevent sensitive information using signatures built for that purpose. However, they do not identify sensitive information on endpoints or in transit.
wrong_explanations.D: Transport Layer Security (TLS) is a network encryption protocol used to protect sensitive information, but it does not have any ability to identify sensitive information.

tips: MOST/PRIMARY questions ask which option carries the largest impact or coverage — rule out partial or downstream choices.

questions.question: Which of the following BEST describes the primary objective of a data loss prevention (DLP) solution?

options.A: To prevent any data loss incidents within an enterprise
options.B: To detect and respond to data loss incidents within an enterprise
options.C: To mitigate the risk of data loss incidents within an enterprise
options.D: To encrypt data within an enterprise to prevent unauthorized access

questions.correct_explanation: The primary objective of a DLP solution is to mitigate the risk of data loss incidents by implementing a range of preventive and detective controls, such as access controls, data classification, encryption, monitoring and response procedures. These controls help prevent unintentional or malicious data loss incidents, detect and respond to incidents promptly, and minimize the impact of data loss incidents on the enterprise.

wrong_explanations.A: A data loss prevention (DLP) solution cannot prevent all data loss incidents, because some data loss incidents may still occur despite the implementation of DLP controls.
wrong_explanations.B: DLP helps to prevent unintentional or malicious data loss incidents, detect and respond to incidents promptly, and minimize the impact of data loss incidents on the enterprise.
wrong_explanations.D: DLP does not encrypt enterprise data; rather, it is used to mitigate the risk of data loss incidents by implementing appropriate controls.

tips: ISACA's BEST answer balances control effectiveness, risk reduction, and auditor independence — eliminate options that compromise any of these.

questions.question: Which of the following would the auditor consider MOST important for effective data protection using a data loss prevention (DLP) solution?

options.A: Ensuring that a single administrator maintains the DLP to prevent data disclosures
options.B: Ensuring that the DLP solution is properly configured and implemented
options.C: Ensuring the effectiveness of the enterprise's DLP policies and procedures
options.D: Ensuring the effectiveness of the encryption and de-identification technologies

questions.correct_explanation: A DLP solution is only as effective as its configuration and implementation. If the DLP solution is not properly configured, it may not be able to detect or prevent sensitive data from being disclosed. Additionally, if the DLP solution is not properly implemented, it may be unable to enforce data protection policies effectively.

wrong_explanations.A: Data loss prevention (DLP) helps to protect the enterprise's sensitive data by applying different controls, and it does not need to be managed by a single administrator.
wrong_explanations.C: The biggest concern to an IS auditor is to identify whether the data loss prevention (DLP) solution is properly configured and implemented to meet the requirements of the enterprise's DLP policies and procedures.
wrong_explanations.D: The objective of DLP is not to encrypt or de-identify data; it is used to mitigate data loss incidents by implementing appropriate controls.

tips: MOST/PRIMARY questions ask which option carries the largest impact or coverage — rule out partial or downstream choices.

questions.question: Which of the following is the MOST effective way to prevent accidental data loss caused by employees?

options.A: Blocking access to all external websites and email domains
options.B: Encrypting all sensitive data on all storage devices within the enterprise
options.C: Conducting regular user awareness training programs
options.D: Implementing strict access controls to restrict employee access to sensitive data

questions.correct_explanation: Accidental data loss caused by employees is a common occurrence in many enterprises. Regular training and awareness programs can help employees understand their roles and responsibilities in protecting sensitive data, identify potential risk and vulnerabilities, and take appropriate measures to prevent data loss incidents. Employee training and awareness are critical to any data protection strategy. Employees need to understand the value of the information that they handle, the consequences of data loss and their role in data protection. Regular training and awareness sessions should be conducted to keep employees updated about best practices for handling and protecting data.

wrong_explanations.A: Blocking access to all external websites and email domains does not prevent all accidental data loss, such as data backup taken following incorrect procedures. The most effective way to prevent such incidents is to educate and train employees on the importance of data protection policies and procedures. Moreover, blocking access to external websites and email domains may hinder business operations and productivity.
wrong_explanations.B: Encrypting all sensitive data on all storage devices may not be practical or necessary for all types of data.
wrong_explanations.D: Strict access controls can help prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data but may not address the risk of accidental data loss caused by authorized users.

tips: MOST/PRIMARY questions ask which option carries the largest impact or coverage — rule out partial or downstream choices.

questions.question: An information systems (IS) auditor observes a cryptocurrency miner on a staff member's computer linked to their account. It is discovered that this is against IT policy. Which of the following would BEST help the enterprise detect these issues sooner?

options.A: Reviewing the computer resources usability and activity report
options.B: Enforcing the software accreditation policy to control software installation
options.C: Organizing awareness workshops on IT policy periodically for users
options.D: Monitoring application logs using an automated log monitoring solution

questions.correct_explanation: Cryptocurrency mining consumes a large amount of computing resources; therefore, regularly reviewing usability and activity reports of computing resources will help to detect unauthorized activity.

wrong_explanations.B: Enforcing the software accreditation policy is a preventive control that will prevent similar incidents in the future but cannot detect the already-implemented tools.
wrong_explanations.C: Awareness training will prevent future incidents but cannot help in detecting an incident.
wrong_explanations.D: Although log monitoring helps in detecting, in this case, the tool is not authorized; therefore, the cryptocurrency mining may not be collected by a log monitoring tool.

tips: ISACA's BEST answer balances control effectiveness, risk reduction, and auditor independence — eliminate options that compromise any of these.

questions.question: Which of the following is the MOST important factor for IT management to consider in developing performance metrics?

questions.question: Which of the following BEST describes the focus of an information systems (IS) auditor when auditing the enterprise architecture (EA)? The IS auditor should:

options.A: follow the overall EA and use the EA as the main source of information.
options.B: use the EA organizational requirements as the audit criteria to assess the conformity of the EA against those requirements.
options.C: ensure that the information systems are in line with the EA and meet the enterprise's objectives.
options.D: review the EA documentation to assess whether the EA conforms with the enterprise's requirements.

wrong_explanations.B: Audit criteria should be established based on and derived from the enterprise's requirements to assess the conformity of the EA against them.
wrong_explanations.D: EA documentation is one of many sources of information that the information systems (IS) auditor uses to collect appropriate and sufficient evidence of conformity.
